name: Jeremiah
desc:
Jeremiah is an Etrean NPC. He can exchange Deep Gems for a random item.

He wears a Vanguard Brace, Vanguard Boots, and Polarised Eyeglasses with the Cutthroat Light Armor outfit.
additional_info: -   Jeremiah is able to give the player all of the Attribute rings besides the Rosen's Ring.
